q25. The engine is CEL via google/cel-go. Its source lives in internal/filter/ (engine.go, parser.go, schema.go, render.go). It compiles the filter string via Engine.Compile. It then builds a dialect-agnostic condition tree via buildCondition. Finally it renders the tree to SQL per dialect through Program.Render.

Dialect-specific SQL is generated by switch statements on DialectName in render.go and schema field Expressions. ListMemos in memo_service.go passes filters to store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/memo.go. AppendConditions calls engine.CompileToStatement. That method compiles the CEL filter and renders the result to SQL for the target dialect.

q25.

**CEL (Common Expression Language) via `github.com/google/cel-go`** in `internal/filter/` (`engine.go`, `parser.go`, `schema.go`, `render.go`).

The filter string is compiled by cel-go into an AST, converted in `internal/filter/parser.go` into a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then rendered to SQL in `internal/filter/render.go` by walking that tree with a `RenderOptions.Dialect` of `sqlite`, `postgres`, or `mysql`—each dialect branch emits different SQL (placeholders, JSON operators, timestamp functions, etc.) that `internal/filter/helpers.go` appends to the store query via `filter.AppendConditions` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`.
